items.headline: Can Albemarle's Lithium Expansion Fuel Sales Volume Growth?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation ALB is strategically executing its projects aimed at boosting its global lithium conversion capacity. ALB saw higher sales volumes (up 11% year over year) in its Energy Storage unit in the second quarter.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 7.8% and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle's shares fell 29.1% in six months as weaker lithium prices pressured the stock. Albemarle expects lithium demand to witness a 10-20% CAGR from 2025 to 2030, led by storage.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: AI Energy Storage Demand Ignites Lithium Prices, Lithium Mining Giants See "Second Growth Engine"
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB.US), the world's largest lithium producer. The company stated that as of May this year, global lithium demand has increased by 45% year-on-year, with supply growth lagging behind demand and inventory remaining tight.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. We are increasing our 2026 and 2030 stationary storage forecast ranges due to that strong demand.
